40007771.author: पदार्थः
40007771.content: ततः then, मारीचः Maricha, एवम् in that way, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा spoken, रात्रिंचरप्रभोः of the king of the nightrangers, भयात् out of fear, दीनः distressed , गच्छाव let us both go, इति thus, रावणम् to Ravana, अब्रवीत् said.

40007771.author: Translation
40007771.content: Having thus spoken to the demonking, the distressed Maricha said out of fear, Let both of us go.

40007772.author: पदार्थः
40007772.content: अहम् I, शरचापासिधारिणा holding bow, arrows and sword, मद्वधोद्यतशस्त्रेऽण who raises weapon to slay me, तेन by him, पुनः again, दृष्टः seen, मे my, जीवितं च विनष्टम्  life will cease.

40007772.author: Translation
40007772.content: If that warrior Rama carrying bow, arrows and sword sees me once again he will raise his weapon to kill me, and I will cease to be.

40007773.author: पदार्थः
40007773.content: रामम् Rama, पराक्रम्य after exhibiting bravery, जीवन् with life, न प्रतिनिवर्तते हि will not return, यमदण्डहतस्य hit by Yama's staff, असौ he, प्रतिरूपः another form, ते to you, वर्तते is being.

40007773.author: Translation
40007773.content: No one who exhibits his heroism before Rama will come back alive. To you, already hit by Yama's staff, he is another form of the same Yama.

40007774.author: पदार्थः
40007774.content: त्वयि when you, एवम् in that way, दुरात्मनि  evilminded, मया I, कि नु what, कर्तुम् to do, शक्यम् is possible, तात dear one, निशाचर O demons, एष here, अहम् I am, गच्छामि  am going, ते to you, स्वस्ति be auspicious, अस्तु let it be.

40007774.author: Translation
40007774.content: What can I do if you remain evilminded? O dear demon, I am going. May your path be auspicious

40007775.author: पदार्थः
40007775.content: सः रावणः that, Ravana, तेन वचनेन with those words, प्रहृष्टः felt happy, तु अभवत् he was, सुसंश्लिष्टम् tightly, परिष्वज्य  embracing, इदम् these, वचनम् words , अब्रवीत् said.

40007775.author: Translation
40007775.content: Ravana was so overwhelmed with joy to hear those words that he embraced him tightly and said:.

40007776.author: पदार्थः
40007776.content: मच्छन्दवशवर्तिनः act according to my wish, ते to you, एतत् this, शौण्डीर्ययुक्तम् it  befits your valour, इदानीम् now, मारीचः Maricha, असि you are, पूर्वम् earlier, अन्यः other, राक्षसः हि demons.

40007776.author: Translation
40007776.content: Act according to my wish. It befits your valour. You were a different demon earlier. Now you are Maricha.

40007777.author: पदार्थः
40007777.content: तथा similarly, पिशाचवदनैः with devilish faces, खरैः with donkeys, युक्तः yoked, रत्नविभूषितः encrusted with gems, रथः chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, मया सह along with me, आरुह्यताम्  ascend.

40007777.author: Translation
40007777.content: Ascend quickly with me this chariot encrusted with gems and yoked with donkeys with devils' faces৷৷

40007778.author: पदार्थः
40007778.content: वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, प्रलोभयित्वा after tempting, यथेष्टम् wherever you like, गन्तुम् to go, अर्हसि should, शून्ये when no one is there, मैथिलीम् princess of Mithila, तां सीताम् that Sita, प्रसभम् forcibly, आनयिष्यामि will bring.

40007778.author: Translation
40007778.content: You may go whereever you like after tempting Vaidehi. When the princess of Mithila  is alone, I will bring her by force.

40007779.author: पदार्थः
40007779.content: ततः thereafter, रावणमारीचौ Ravana and Maricha, तं रथम् that chariot, विमानमिव like an aerial chariot, आरुह्य  ascending, तस्मात् from that, आश्रममण्डलात् cluster of hermitages, शीघ्रम् quickly, ययतुः departed.

40007779.author: Translation
40007779.content: Thereafter Ravana and Maricha ascended the chariot, which was like an aerial car, and quickly departed from that cluster of hermitages.

40007780.author: पदार्थः
40007780.content: तथैव and likewise, तत्र there, पत्तनानि towns, वनानि च and forests, गिरींश्च mountains, सर्वाः all, सरितः streams, राष्ट्राणि states, नगराणि च cities, पश्यन्तौ seeing

40007780.author: Translation
40007780.content: And likewise, they went past towns, forests, mountains, streams, states and cities.

40007781.author: पदार्थः
40007781.content: सहमारीचः accompanied by Maricha, राक्षसाधिपः king of demons, रावणः Ravana, दण्डकारण्यम् Dandaka forest, समेत्य reached, ततः then, राघवस्य Rama's, आश्रमम् hermitage, ददर्श noticed.

40007781.author: Translation
40007781.content: Ravana, king of the demons, accompanied by Maricha, then reached Dandaka forest and saw Rama's hermitage.

40007782.author: पदार्थः
40007782.content: रावणः Ravana, काञ्चनभूषणात् decorated with golden ornaments, तस्मात् from that, रथात् chariot, अवतीर्य  getting down, ततः then, मारीचम् Maricha, हस्ते by hand, गृहीत्वा, held, वाक्यम्  words, अब्रवीत् said.

40007782.author: Translation
40007782.content: Then Ravana got off the chariot decorated with golden embellishments and, holding Maricha's hand, said:.

40007783.author: पदार्थः
40007783.content: सखे O friend, कदलीवृतम् surrounded by banana plants, एतत् this, तत् that, आश्रमपदम् site of hermitage, दृश्यते is seen, वयम् we, यदर्थम् the purpose for which, आगताः we came, तत् that, शीघ्रम् quickly, क्रियताम् should be done.

40007783.author: Translation
40007783.content: O friend here is the site of the hermitage surrounded by banana plants. Quickly get to work on the purpose for which we have come.

40007784.author: पदार्थः
40007784.content: तदा then, सः that, राक्षसः demon, मारीचः Maricha, रावणवचः Ravana's words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, मृगः deer, भूत्वा transformed, रामस्य Rama's, आश्रमद्वारि at the entrance of the hermitage, विचचार ह started moving.

40007784.author: Translation
40007784.content: Hearing Ravana's words, Maricha transformed himself into a deer and started moving at the entrance of Rama's hermitage.

40007785.author: पदार्थः
40007785.content: सः Maricha, अद्भुतदर्शनम् wonderful to look at, महत् magnificent, तत् that, रूपम् form, आस्थाय  assumed, मणिप्रवरशृङ्गाग्रः antlers studded with the best of gems, सितासितमुखाकृतिः face dappled with luminous spots of white and black.

40007785.author: Translation
40007785.content: Maricha assumed the form of a wonderful and magnificent deer with his antlers studded with the most precious gems, his face dappled with luminous spots of white and  black.

40007786.author: पदार्थः
40007786.content: रक्तपद्मोत्पलमुखः mouth like  pink lotus, इन्द्रनीलोत्पलश्रवाः  ears  like blue lotus, किञ्चित् a bit, अभ्युन्नतग्रीवः  raised neck, इन्द्रनीलदलाधरः lips like petals of blue lotus.

40007786.author: Translation
40007786.content: The deer's face was like a pink lotus, his ears were like blue lotus. His neck slightly raised, his lips were like petals of blue lotus.

40007787.author: पदार्थः
40007787.content: अस्य its, भास्वरम् shining, उदरम् stomach, कुन्देन्दुवज्रसङ्काशम् like white kunda flower, Moon and diamond, मधूकनिभपार्श्वश्च sides like madhuka flowers, पद्मकिञ्जल्कसन्निभः comparable to the filaments of lotus, वैडूर्यसङ्काशखुरः hooves like Vaidurya, तनुजङ्घः slim shank, सुसंहतः willshaped.

40007787.author: Translation
40007787.content: His bright belly was shining like kunda flowers or the Moon or diamond. His flanks were like the golden madhuka flowers. comparable to the filaments of lotus. His hooves were like vaidurya, and his legs were slim and willshaped.

40007788.author: पदार्थः
40007788.content: ऊर्ध्वम् upward, विराजता stood, इन्द्रायुध like a rainbow, सवर्णेन colourful, पुच्छेन with the tail, मनोहरः delightful, स्निग्धवर्णः shining, नानाविधैः various, रत्नैः gems, वृतः decked.

40007788.author: Translation
40007788.content: His tail stood up looking magnificent like a colourful rainbow. Bedecked with various gems, he shone beautiful.

40007789.author: पदार्थः
40007789.content: राक्षसः the demon, वनम् forest, रम्यम् beautiful, तत् रामाश्रमपदम् that Rama's hermitage, प्रज्वलयन् while brightening, क्षणेन in a moment, परमशोभनः very beautiful, मृगः deer, जातः was transformed.

40007789.author: Translation
40007789.content: Transformed into a most beautiful deer in a moment, Maricha brightened the beautiful forest and Rama's hermitage.

40007790.author: पदार्थः
40007790.content: सः that, राक्षसः demon, नानाधातुविचित्रितम् painted with colours of different minerals, मनोहरम् delightful, दर्शनीयम् beautiful, रूपम् form, कृत्वा after transforming, वैदेह्याः to Sita, प्रलोभनार्थम् to tempt, विचरन् while grazing, तस्मात् from that place, समन्ततः all around, शाद्वलानि grassland, गच्छते moved about.

40007790.author: Translation
40007790.content: Transfigured into a beautiful, magnificent form painted with the colours of different minerals in order to tempt Sita, Maricha roamed all around the grassland.

40007791.author: पदार्थः
40007791.content: सः that, राक्षसः demon, नानाधातुविचित्रितम् painted with colours of different minerals, मनोहरम् delightful, दर्शनीयम् beautiful, रूपम् form, कृत्वा after transforming, वैदेह्याः to Sita, प्रलोभनार्थम् to tempt, विचरन् while grazing, तस्मात् from that place, समन्ततः all around, शाद्वलानि grassland, गच्छते moved about.

40007791.author: Translation
40007791.content: Transfigured into a beautiful, magnificent form painted with the colours of different minerals in order to tempt Sita, Maricha roamed all around the grassland.

40007792.author: पदार्थः
40007792.content: सः that, रूप्यैः by silver, बिन्दुशतैः with hudreds of spots, चित्रः was wonderful, भूत्वा on transforming, प्रियदर्शनः pleasing to the eyes, विटपीनाम् trees, किसलयान् tender leaves, भङ्त्क्वा nibbling, अदन् eating, विचचार ह wandered about.

40007792.author: Translation
40007792.content: That deer with hundreds of silver spots on the body appeared enchanting and pleasing to the eyes while he wandered about nibbling the tender leaves of trees.

40007793.author: पदार्थः
40007793.content: कदलीगृहकम् groves of banana, गत्वा on going, कर्णिकारान् the karnikara flowers, इतस्ततः hither and thither, मन्दगतिः at a slow pace, तथा likewise, सीतासन्दर्शनम् the sight of Sita, समाश्रयत् resorted.

40007793.author: Translation
40007793.content: The deer went wandering about the banana groves surrounding Rama's hermitage and moved slowly towards the karnikara trees in order to catch the attention of Sita.

40007794.author: पदार्थः
40007794.content: सः that, महामृगः magnificent deer, राजीवचित्रपृष्ठः his back with the colour of blue lotus, विरराज glittered, रामाश्रमपदाभ्याशे in the vicinity of Rama's hermitage, यथासुखम् comfortably, विचचार wandered.

40007794.author: Translation
40007794.content: That magnificent deer glittered with the colour of blue lotus on its back, wandered merrily in the vicinity of Rama's hermitage.

40007795.author: पदार्थः
40007795.content: मृगोत्तमः best of deer, गत्वा on going, पुनः again, निवृत्तश्च came back, विचचार wandered, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, गत्वा after going, पुनः again, त्वरया swiftly, प्रतिनिवर्तते returned.

40007795.author: Translation
40007795.content: The wonderful deer moved to and fro, now disappearing and now swiftly returning.

40007796.author: पदार्थः
40007796.content: विक्रीडंश्च while sporting so, पुनरेव again, क्वचित् sometimes, भूमौ on the ground, पुनरेव again, निषीदति squat, आश्रमद्वारम् at the entrance of the hermitage, आगम्य after reaching, मृगयूथानि flock of deer, गच्छति goes.

40007796.author: Translation
40007796.content: The deer is now sporting, now sitting on the ground, now standing at the entrance of the hermitage and now running with the herds of deer.

40007797.author: पदार्थः
40007797.content: मृगताम् form of a deer, गतः transformed, राक्षसः demon, सीतादर्शनम् seeing Sita, आकांक्षन् intending, मृगयूथैः herds of deer, अनुगतः been followed, पुनरेव again, निवर्तते he retuned, विनिष्पतन्  cavorted and pranced, चित्राणि wonderful, मण्डलानि circles, परिभ्रमति turned round.

40007797.author: Translation
40007797.content: Followed by herds of deer and coming back to see Sita again and again, the deer cavorted and pranced and frisked in circles in a wonderful way.

40007798.author: पदार्थः
40007798.content: वनेचराः wandering in the forest, अन्ये other, ते those, सर्वे all, मृगाः deer, समुद्विक्ष्य seeing, उपागम्य on coming near, समाघ्राय sniffing, दश दिशः in all ten directions, विद्रवन्ति run away,

40007798.author: Translation
40007798.content: Seeing the deer, other animals wandering in the forest come near and sniffing him run away in all ten directions.

40007799.author: पदार्थः
40007799.content: मृगवधे in killing deer, रतः interested, सः he, राक्षसोऽपि demon also, वन्यान् those wild, तान् those, मृगान् deer, संस्पृशन् touching and feeling, भावस्य his intention, प्रच्छादनार्थम् to hide, न भक्षयति does not feed on.

40007799.author: Translation
40007799.content: The demon who was interested in killing wild deer touched and felt them but did not kill or feed on them in order to hide his intention.

40007800.author: पदार्थः
40007800.content: ततः then, तस्मिन्नेव काले at that time, शुभलोचना lady of auspicious looks, वैदेही Vaidehi, कुसुमावचयव्यग्रा busy plucking flowers, पादपान् the trees, अभ्यवर्तत came near,

40007800.author: Translation
40007800.content: In the mean time Sita who, with her auspicious looks, was busy plucking flowers drew near the trees.

40007801.author: पदार्थः
40007801.content: मदिरेक्षणा woman with bewitching eyes, रुचिरानना of dazzling face, कर्णिकारान् karnikara trees, अशोकांश्छ ashoka, चूतांश्च mango, कुसुमानि flowers, अवचिन्वन्ती while plucking, चचार went about.

40007801.author: Translation
40007801.content: With her bewitching eyes and beautiful face, Sita, went about plucking flowers from karnikara, ashoka and mango trees.

40007802.author: पदार्थः
40007802.content: अरण्यवासस्य of living in the forest, अनर्हा unworthy, सा that, परमाङ्गना great woman, रत्नमयम् encrusted with gold, मुक्तामणिविचित्राङ्गम् with a wonderful body dotted with pearls and gems, तं मृगम् that deer, ददर्श saw.

40007802.author: Translation
40007802.content: The great lady Sita, unworthy of dwelling in the forest, saw the wonderful deer decked with gems, with  spots of pearls all over the body.

40007803.author: पदार्थः
40007803.content: रुचिरदन्तोष्ठी a lady of beautiful teeth and lips, सा that Sita, रूप्यधातुतनूरुहम् animal with silver and mineral coloured hair on the body, तम् deer, विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना with eyes of wonder and joy, सस्नेहम् with affection, समुदैक्षत gazed at.

40007803.author: Translation
40007803.content: A lady with beautiful teeth and lips, Sita saw the deer having silver and mineral coloured hair on the body. She gazed at the animal with wonder and joy and love.

40007804.author: पदार्थः
40007804.content: मायामयः illusory one, सः that, मृगश्च the deer, तां her, रामदयिताम् Rama's wife, पश्यन् on seeing, तत् वनम् that forest, दीपयन्निव as if illuminating, पुनः again, चित्रम् wonderfully, विचचार moved around.

40007804.author: Translation
40007804.content: That illusory deer saw Rama's wife and moved around wonderfully as if illuminating the forest with his radiance.

40007805.author: पदार्थः
40007805.content: अदृष्टपूर्वम् never seen before, नानारत्नमयम् decorated with different gems, तं मृगम् that deer, दृष्ट्वा seeing, जनकात्मजा daughter of Janaka, सीता Sita, परमम् very much, विस्मयम् surprised, जगाम experienced.

40007805.author: Translation
40007805.content: Seeing such  an unprecedented deer decorated with different gems, Sita, daughter of Janaka, stood amazed. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्विचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysecond sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
